summary: Base system prompt (src/system_prompt.rs): pi-style role + per-tool usage guide stating caps, pagination and truncation rules (read_file max_bytes cap + line-range continuation, read_tool_output offset paging, run_command artifact hint, list/search/find caps); one Environment line (cwd, UTC date, OS-arch); AGENTS.md discovery with per-directory CLAUDE.md fallback over global $ZENPI_HOME then workspace root (.git ancestor) down to cwd, merged global -> root -> cwd under '## <path>' headers with a 64 KiB total cap (truncation marker, later files omitted); unreadable/non-UTF-8/non-regular files skipped with AgentEvent::Warning; SYSTEM.md replaces and APPEND_SYSTEM.md appends (project .zenpi/ nearest-first, then global). Agent prepends the prompt (built once per turn) to request instructions, so it counts toward the context budget; agents without a tool workspace send none.
